construction_sents: After removing the bottle from the warmer, I turned the warmer on its side which is supposed to stop the heating function, but I noticed that the little red light that indicates the device is heating came on.
For a bottle warmer that costs $79.99 USD, this should not leak, and the automatic turning off of the heating element should work as advertised, but the one I received did not.
It is possible that I simply received a dud, but for the price I am not impressed.
I received this set in mint green.
The presentation of this set is absolutely lovely.
It arrives in a sturdy box that would make it nice to give as a gift.
The silicone mat and the manta ray wrap are the real stars of this set.
The silicone mat is thick enough that baby can not pick it up, but light enough to use every day.
It is easy to clean the mat (wipe food off with a wet wipe) and the silicone manta ray wrap is simple to use for traveling with this mat.
I do not like the bib.
I noticed a plastic smell when opening the bib and it has not dissipated despite several rounds of handwashing.
This bib takes quite a while to dry, and it has discolored where I put some dish detergent mixed with water on it, which is disappointingsince the design is cute.
The feature where you can attach the bib to the silicone mat did not work well for us as our little one kept accidentally pulling the mat up while trying to eat.
I believe it is priced on the high side due to the issues with the bib, but the silicone mat is fantastic.
This is the third diaper bag of this type that I own.
I like the sturdiness of the name tag holder, it is stronger than many others i have seen.
The front pocket has 3 built in bottle holders featuring space blanket material to keep the bottles at the desired temperature.
There is a zippered pocket on the inside of the front flap of the front pocket that can hold a snack or a few diapers.
The bassinet has plastic piping held together with a nylon rope in the center.

The plastic piping slides together on each side to set up the bassinet, the sun-blocking fabric across the top is able to be secured with velcro, and has another pocket (and truly unique feature): presumably to roll up and store the sun-blocking fabric in.
Another feature of this bag that differentiates it from other diaper bags is that the soft bassinet "mattress" doubles as a diaper changing pad with its wipes pocket and waterproof backing.
The interior of the bag has plenty of space: there is one pocket on each side and two pockets on the interior front, along with a zippered pocket on the back of the interior.

Along with all of the interior pockets, this bag has a USB port on the outer side of the bag to plug a portable charger into and a USB cable attached to the inside of the bag to charge your device (a tablet or laptop would work best there).
In addition, there is one pocket on either side of the outside of this bag.
There is also a "secret" pocket on the back of the bag that is just big enough to fit a phone, maybe a mask and set of keys inside.
The back of the bag is padded for comfort.

There are several options to carry the bag: one is via the stroller straps (make sure to hold the stroller to ensure it does not have enough weight to pull the stroller over), over the shoulder via the padded backpack straps, or via the handles on top of the bag that snap together.
It is perfect for trips to Grandma's house or anywhere else you might like to travel with baby.
We received this in the "pink" color, although it is more like a flourescent orange color with pink threads woven through---it is not a big deal for us but some people might be disappointed.

There is a photo comparing a hot pink item of clothing to the orange color of this bag so you can spot the color difference as it does not translate well in photographs of the bag by itself.
The canvas material makes this bag quite sturdy and it will likely last for many years to come.
The leather zipper pulls are an attractive addition, making this bag seem more luxe.
It is a very spacious diaper bag with a whole lot of pockets (including a semi insulated bottle pocket with room for 3 bottles).
There are 3 zippered pockets in the front with one open pocket on each side, inside there are 4 open pockets and 2 zippered pockets.
It also has a USB port and cable to attach a power bank for charging your devices on the go (this would probably work better for a laptop or tablet rather than a phone).
The included bassinet is a clever design: the zipper unzips completely and the plastic poles have nylon cord running through them to make setup faster and results in a sturdier design.

The inner comfort pad is included, and allows for fast diaper changes in the park, or anywhere else you may need a clean place to lay your baby (always being sure to keep an eye on your little one while they are in the bassinet of course!)
This diaper bag has both padded straps and a padded lumbar area, making it more comfortable to carry.

The additional stroller straps are a nice feature, however too much weight in the bag can cause smaller or lightweight strollers to tip or fall backwards so please be cognizant of that and only use the stroller straps if you will be standing or walking with your hands on the stroller.
The carry handles on the top of the bag can be clipped together with the included snap.
The added pacifier case is cute.
This is absolutely worth the price: the only thing that would make it better would be to include a wipes case.
[[VIDEOID:d02e65bc47fd573462fe2438e692c4d3]] This baby food maker is one amazing machine!
The flashing light indicates it is working (do not be a silly person like me who thought that the flashing light meant the function was paused).
It takes a few minutes for the water in the basin to heat
but that is to be expected.
This baby food maker makes perfect hardboiled eggs---no green yolks.
The  bottle sterilizing function is fantastic also!
The blade works very well to puree food.
The company apologized for the difficulty, then they requested photos or video of the issue so they can properly troubleshoot the problem.
They even stated that they would be happy to refund the money or replace the product.
I would gladly buy one of their products for their excellent customer service alone, but if you are hesitating to buy this baby food maker, just take the plunge---
it's a wonderful product from a fantastic company.
This portable booster seat comes in a variety of colors, including this cute pink strawberry design.
The tray is the only piece that needed to be assembled upon arrival, and assembly was simple as it clicks into place on both sides.
The tray has a bonus cup/bottle holder, making it easier to keep baby's cup or bottle on the tray.
It has an easily adjusted 3 point harness, allowing for more space to be used as needed.
The straps are good quality and it is simple to open and close the harness, although if a slight adjustment to a 5 point harness was made it would allow slightly younger babies to use this seat.
The seat itself is made of a waterproof fabric that is very easy to wipe clean after baby's meal.
There are actually 4 heights: one with the legs fully tucked under the chair, then 3 with the legs at differing heights.

The ability to have the legs tucked under fully (along with the use of the outer straps) allows the use of a dining room chair to be used---this can aid in transitioning the little one to a "grown up" seat.
The straps allow for a very secure attachment to the "grown up" chair.
I tested this after adjusting the straps to the correct length this seat did not move even when being wiggled from side to side, & up and down.
The best part is that this chair takes up very little space when folded, making it a great seat to take when traveling with your little one!
I really like the canvas material of this bag for sturdiness and longevity of use.
The nylon straps are strong, although they are not indestructible or "theft-proof" nor do they have a comfort strap to reduce the likelihood of having marks on your shoulder from carrying this bag.
However, the extras (included id card area, the luggage strap, and the front pocket) all make it easier and more enjoyable to carry a booster seat when traveling.
The zippers are of good quality and appear to be heavier than average (although they are not the YKK zippers).
I like it now for the convenience of taking our extra booster seat to Grandma's house and anywhere else we need to travel.
The best part is that becomes its own bag when it is not in use, and is fairly easy to toss into a diaper bag or suitcase on the go.
This mat is gigantic compared to other baby mats we own.
It nearly covers the entire floor of our entertainment room!
It is quite soft due to the quilting and the stitching appears to be well-done so it should last for a long time.
The animal/forest design is adorable and the baby enjoys the bright colors of the animals and trees.

The non-skid surface on the bottom of this mat is better than some we own, but is really better suited as a non-skid mat on a carpet rather than hardwood floors---although it does limit the movement of the rug across the hardwood floor.
(I get migraines from strong odors, especially odors like patchouli which this mat smelled strongly of---so much for an odorless mat!)
Otherwise, it is exactly as advertised and the pricing is similar to other baby mats of similar sizing.
This is our fourth pack and play mattress, and I must say it is quite soft.
This mattress fits very well in our dream on me pack and play.
It was quick to begin expanding once opened and has expanded to about the same height as two of our other pack and play mattresses (between 2 and 3 inches tall).
Unlike many of these types of mattresses, this one has a firmer side for newborn babies and a softer side for older babies/toddlers.
Our little one likes the pack and play for naptime so much more with the mattress.
The softness is about the same as a crib mattress, but the dimensions are clearly for pack and plays.
(We have found that Graco and Dream on Me pack and plays have the same inside dimensions, allowing mattresses to be transferred between the two).

If you are planning on traveling with this mattress, and not leaving the pack and play set up, then storage might be more of a challenge unless you have a way to pack and vacuum seal it in a bag or have a strap that could be used to roll it.
It was relatively simple to assemble this high chair, we had it together in under 10 minutes.
The fabric on the high chair is very easy to wipe clean, yet has enough inner padding that baby is able to remain in the seat comfortably for the entire meal.
The tray is easy to clean and has a nice cup/bottle holder.
The tray is able to be moved closer or further from the baby as shown in the photos.
The ability to recline the seat is an interesting feature, although not a necessary one for us.
The high chair folds down relatively small, but the footrest has a tendency to stick out.
The footrest is a nice feature to use as the child grows.
I also really like that this high chair has a 5 point harness that is easy to put on and take off of the little one.
The harness system is easy to adjust and easy to use, even with a squiggly baby.
I like the additional safety feature of the leg separator on the tray that can assist with keeping baby from wiggling down too far in the high chair during mealtimes.
This high chair is not as tall as others we've had, but I feel that this adds to the stability of this high chair concomitantly allowing for the chair to be more compact when not in use.
It is lightweight and easy to carry, perfect for trips to visit family or friends.
This was intuitive to assemble and took less than 10 minutes to accomplish.
This is a fantastic product for people who have a mobile that does not fit on their crib.
It is very stable, I attempted to knock it over with reasonable force (imitating knocking into it accidentally) several times and it did not fall.
The wood look is rather pretty and fits well with most decor.
Once the package was opened the mattress fluffed up quickly.
The mattress fits well in our pack & play, leaving no gaps around the sides.
Our little one appears to enjoy napping on it.
We like how easy it is to fold and place in the enclosed bag for travel and storage.
The trifold design makes it quite simple to fold and unfold, and when it is unfolded in the pack & play it leaves no gaps where the baby could get stuck.
The bag that comes with this mattress is not very sturdy but it will keep dust away from the mattress when not in use.
The designs on these blankets are quite adorable, but the blankets sure are thin.
They are a muslin-like material that is perfect for baby's late spring and summertime naps.
I would not get these for use in winter, fall, or colder temperatures.
Our little one likes the feel of these blankets as they are decently soft.
I received this in beige, in the large size.
This bra is truly a hands free pumping bra.

The material is stretchy enough to accommodate the flanges of my breast pump, but sturdy enough to hold the flanges in place during pumping, while also being strong enough to hold the bags or bottles that are being filled.
The material is both soft and comfortable: it also comes with a bra extender, making it more forgiving for a postpartum woman's body.
I like that it is easy to use and allows me to use my hands for other things (like folding laundry or checking emails for work) while pumping.
It is not machine washable and must be washed by hand and hung up to dry.
We are using this mattress in our Dream on Me pack n play (same dimensions as the Graco Pack n Play in Basin) for little one's day time naps.
Ours was also folded in half, the crease is still there
but I am sure this will flatten out with more time and more use.

We also use a fitted mattress protector for pack n plays on this and secured it with sheet clips, (frankly the sheet clips may not be necessary as the fitted mattress protector fits perfectly on this, but

c'est la vie).
After letting the mattress air out and expand a bit, we placed the fitted mattress protector on top and used it for our little one's nap time.
Our little one usually fusses when placed in her pack n play for nap time, but this time the baby went right to sleep and stayed asleep for the whole nap without tossing or turning.
If that does not speak to the added comfort this mattress provides for little ones I don't know what will.
These fitted sheets are perfect for use with standard pack and plays, or standard sized pack and play mattresses.

The silver-colored waterproof portion that is sewn to the inside of the sheet provides perfect waterproofing, ensuring that the mattress does not get wet (which is great when you have a little one that is prone to drooling or spitting up).
Of course, like with any waterproof material it will need to be wiped or washed, depending on the material that is spilled on it.
These fitted sheets are machine washable (machine wash cold, tumble dry low), which is a big plus as anyone with a child knows how often they will need to be washed.
The elastic around the edges grips the mattress firmly and does not allow for any excess air or gapping of material which can be a concern with this type of sheet.
The colors of these fitted sheets are vibrant (we received them in blue and gray).
The star pattern for the quilting is different from any pack and play fitted sheets that I have seen before, making it easy to differentiate between brands of sheets.
This is a large and fairly extensive set, the colors are even nicer in person.
This set is especially beneficial for those who want to leave a set of toddler dishware at the grandparents house, and have a set at home (or a home set and travel set, or simply two sets for home).
The pieces (bowls, plates, cups, snack cups, spoons, forks, snack bowls and lids, even the bibs) are very easy to clean and they dry rapidly.
Just 5 minutes after washing them by hand, the spoons and forks were fully dry and the other items did not take long after that to finish drying.
Surprisingly, the cups took the longest to dry on their own.
The plates are heavier than I anticipated, which is excellent for keeping them on the tray.
Perhaps just leave the bibs out of this set altogether, bibs that attach with velcro are more convenient for parents and caregivers.
I like that this bath kneeled comes with a det of knee and elbow pads---finally!
I can say goodbye to painful knees when bathing the baby or the puppy!
The knee pads have nonskid bottoms that are actually nonskid, and velcro to fold them up and hold them together when you're done using them.
The elbow pads with the dual sided storage for toys, washcloths, or soap/shampoo are really nice.
The neoprene is water resistant but not water proof.
These elbow and knee pads initially allow the water to bead up so if you catch it quicly you can just wipe it off, but prolonged contact will result in water absorption.
The suction cups are okay, but they are not the strongest hold, which really isn't a problem I guess since they're not meant to be a permanent structure.
The one thing that I do not like is that these knee and elbow pads are still off gassing (strong scent when the bag is opened or when knee and elbow pads are used.)
These are similar to the ones I recall my parents having on our cabinets growing up.
They are a basic slide lock mechanism that can work with different varieties of cabinet handles as seen in my photos.
Every household with a toddler should have cabinet locks at least under the kitchen sink and bathroom sink to prevent little ones from ingesting chemicals that are unfit for human consumption.
These cabinet locks fit the bill: inexpensive, easy to install, easy for adults to remove.

They are made of a cheaper plastic, but I anticipated that due to the low price (around USD$1.25ish per lock), so it comes as no surprise that their simple design allows for the lock to slide fully off of the rails (only when held open).
I was so excited to receive and use this hands-free breastpump...but sadly it is not easier than using my regular pump.
It even left marks on my breast and around my areola.

It is about the same level of noise as my madela double electric pump, but took over twice as long to produce milk from one breast (with my madela pump, I can get 6 to 8 ounces from both breasts in 15 minutes without pain).
Then, when I went to pour the breastmilk from the reservoir, it left an entire ounce trapped in the chamber.

I tried pouring it into the bottle by turning the reservoir in different directions but no matter how hard I tried the milk was trapped and as every breastfeeding mom knows: breastmilk is liquid gold and every ounce counts.
Ladies, save your money and buy a better pump.
This nap mat's design (outside: pink and purple galaxy, inside: assorted color stars on white background) is very cool, and fun for a young toddler.
The attached nylon handle and loops with velcro assure that this sleeping mat is well secured for travel or storing.

This mat is a little smaller than others we own, so this might not work for older elementary age kids, depending on their height.
The tag is worded a little oddly and could be embarrassing for older toddlers (it says my Darling baby)
so if that is a concern, I would simply cut that tag off.
Ours is going to Grandma's house for use while babysitting our little one, so that is not a worry for us.
I like that this nap mat is machine washable, and the pillow fluffs up nicely but could be a smidgen larger to fit in the attached pillowcase a little bit better.
I was hesitant to order these because I was skeptical about the level of suction these bowls would have.
I received the pink bowl and the beige bowl: they are only slightly larger than our Re-Play bowls.
After receiving (and washing) the bowls, I placed them on the tray that attaches to our little one's highchair.
As you can see from the photos, the suction on these bowls is STRONG!
I flipped the tray on its side, no movement.
Then I held the tray upside down and shook it---still NO movement!!!
It wasn't until I lifted the tab on the bowls that I was able to remove them from the tray.
Unless your toddler is extraordinarily intelligent or the Hulk, they will not be able to remove these bowls and throw them.
This fabric basket with reinforced handles is lightweight compared to other fabric baskets we own.
It is larger than it appears online with plenty of space to hold multiple dvd stacks (approximately 150 dvd cases with dvds), 3 mermaid blankets, a folded rug, a larger blanket and a baby blanket.
The tri-color design adds an attractive element making this storage basket lovely to look at as well as functional.
The reinforced handles ensure that it is easily carried between rooms, and the rectangular design allows for more functionality of space than the typical round fabric basket.
(This is larger and holds more than a 16x16 square fabric cube, but takes up about the same amount of area in the sides with the handles).
The stitching is clean and close, unlike other fabric baskets we own and seems to be more of a long-term storage solution than our other fabric baskets.
The fabric colors and designs are unisex, and the colors are lovely and lightweight.
The fabric is soft and gets softer after being washed.
These sheets are machine washable (cold water, tumble dry low).
Unfortunately I misread the size and ordered the wrong size for my baby's mattress (mini crib mattress rather than normal sized crib mattress)
so I am unable to evaluate based upon size/fit and stretch.
These pillows arrived each in their own vacuum sealed plastic bag inside of a box.
Once these pillows were removed from their packaging they started to expand, although they were not very fluffy, even after two days of being allowed to expand.
After washing and drying these pillows (and yes, they truly are machine washable), boy did these pillows fluff up!
They went from about an inch of fluffy prior to washing to six inches of fluffiness after being washed and dried.
The unicorn design on each pillow is so stinking adorable.
I took a nap using these pillows and they surprisingly kept their fluffiness
We received this blanket in the design Unicorn 2.
It arrived well packaged inside an amazon bag (then inside a drawstring bag and wrapped with a lovely little red ribbon).
This blanket is brightly colored and just as lovely as it is online.
It is also extremely soft and is the perfect size for a newborn baby.
I would not say it will grow with them throughout toddlerhood as it is on the small side.
It is machine washable, but I did not use the dryer instead choosing to use the hang dry method so I can not speak to whether it pills or not.
If you are looking for a baby shower gift, this sure is a lovely one!
This mirror will only work if you have an adjustable headrest in your backseat: do not purchase this if you have headrests that are attached in a fixed position.
The rubberized strap to hold the mirror to the headrest is quite sturdy and strong, and the cross velcro pieces to secure the attachment provide an even better hold for the mirror.
The mirror itself is large and allows for a whole lot of baby viewing ability.
My little one likes looking at themselves in the car and this also provides added peace of mind for me, knowing my little one is safe and happy.
I was able to install these in minutes by myself.
The black on black matches my car's interior, and the non-skid backing allows for easier placement of the covers.

Just remember that if one is giving this as a gift, either the giver will have to assemble it or point the receiver to the Amazon video.
/>I just unfolded the unit, turned it over, and snapped in the rectangular support rod with the nubs facing toward the holes so that it would click in place - see photo.
I repeated with the rods for the bottom tray.
There are also two straps underneath that get secured around the center legs and some tiny strap loops to Velcro to the bars where the bassinet hangs.
I then installed the hard bed insert and the unit was ready to go.
The basket is adjustable and has seven height adjustments.

It is important to reseat it with the tab facing down so that it locks in place.
/>My cats love this bassinet, so it is great for pets too--especially if it is "plushed" up with a nice soft blanket.

It does come with its own nice hard insert but that is not plush as is correct for a newborn.

In summary, this bassinet is excellent.
It is sturdy, easy to assemble, easy to adjust, and has a sufficient access door.
Bassinets are perfect for infants up to about six months old or up to when they reach 20 pounds and can roll over.
Once they reach that stage, a crib should be used as it is unsafe to use after that.
Of course, it is also perfect for pets and they would like both the bassinet and tray underneath.
I do wish the pamphlet they provided came with the full assembly instructions and not just the instructions for securing the straps to a bed.
Nevertheless, I did not mark this down for that because assembly is intuitive and easy.

Pros:
* Able to block off odd spaces
* Can accommodate very large or smaller spaces
* Easy to set up

Cons:
*
A little difficult to close/lock

Mesh covering cannot be removed

This gate is probably one of the most useful safety items we've gotten for our little one.
We don't have a very large house
but I wanted to give him as much play room as I could in the family area.

Unfortunately it's kind of an odd space to separate the dining and living room, so for a while we just used large Rubbermaid containers, but that was extremely annoying; having to move things back and forth every day.

Because this gate can expand very wide and panels can be used to fit any type of space it was perfect for us.

I also like the mesh feature.
Normal gates with the bars kind of look like I've got my baby in prison, not to mention just big metal things for him to bang his head against, and more slots for him to get limbs stuck.
However, the mesh is not removable, so if he makes a mess on it the only way to clean is wiping it by hand.
I would have liked to be able to launder this once in a while.

He's constantly "french kissing" it so it just would have been nice to be able to wash it properly.

Lastly, while getting the gate open isn't too difficult, putting it back properly to get it locked in place is kind of annoying.
You have to make sure you align it just right and jiggle it around a bit so it locks.

Pros:
* Relatively easy installation
*

No need to screw into the walls
* Easy to close or keep open the gate

Cons:
The gate requires a little jiggling during the lift to get it open and when it's closed, locked or not, it doesn't look like it'll hold.
I have a feeling when my little one gets bigger he may be able to damage the peg that holds the door in place.
/>The easy close function is awesome.
As long as you don't open it too wide, it'll close on its own no matter which way I open it (forward or back).
In order to keep it open, you just open it a little wider and it locks in place.
You essentially don't need your hands at all except to initially open it.
I definitely recommend this gate.

*Update:
Turns out, they do make another version with a screw on lid.
It's better in other ways too; there's an attached lid that goes right on top of the catcher lid.

AND, you pick the color -- http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B00B59PVOA?psc=1&redirect=true&ref_=oh_aui_search_detailpage

I'm
so disappointed with this snack catcher!
Sure, it does what it's supposed to, so long as your baby isn't the curious type who likes to take everything apart.

He figured out two ways to get the lid off, either just sliding it right off from the outside, or sticking his hand through the top and yanking it off that way.
/>I'm giving it an extra star (2/5) because it's a cute cup, great concept and better quality than others I've seen but with the lid coming right off it defeats the purpose.
They should really make a screw on lid.

/>My son has eczema which is exacerbated by heat & drool.
It's especially bad on the front of his ankles where it gets a little inflamed & scabby.
He also scratches at it if I don't put vaseline or oatmeal based creams on it.
On his lower cheeks, chin, jaw and neck it gets pretty bad because of all the drool.
Of course I do my best to keep it dry, and I put a vaseline barrier as often as I can, but it's often pretty red and splotchy.
Especially when the heat & humidity hit (we're in Hawai`i).

/>As the doctor and other moms have recommended, I use a vaseline or aquaphor barrier, and twice a day I'd apply Babyganics "Bye bye dry" eczema care cream, and if it was bad enough hydrocortisone cream/ointment or desitin.
These things all worked a bit, sometimes his skin would look almost normal, but it wasn't 100%, and there were too many occurrences of rash or scabbing.
More recently eczema patches have been popping up around other areas on his body, so I really felt like I wanted to try something new.
/>I decided to give this a try and I'm really glad I did.
It came in yesterday and I applied it before bedtime after making sure I cleaned and dried all the affected areas first (particularly his face/neck because of the drool).
This morning I checked him out and no kidding, his skin is clear.

There's still evidence that he had something wrong with his skin, as the pigmentation is a little lighter, but all the redness & inflammation is gone, and besides a few tiny scabs on his ankles, they are also clear.

/>I really wish I had taken before & after photos, but it's too late for that now, and I'm not about to let his rash come back just for that purpose, so I'm hoping this review is enough to encourage other mom's out there to give it a try.
